moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio fade-slide, written here): Card: y +24 → 0 px and opacity 0 → 1 together, 600 ms power2.out (easeOutCubic; site bezier .33,1,.68,1), both ending on the same frame. Site loop 2400 ms: enters at 300 ms, holds, then fades out (no move) in 420 ms power2.in from 1900 ms. Site tip: 12–32 px of travel. Params: duration (0.6 s) · y: quãng trượt (24 px) · ease (power2.out).
